summary: Tested Auto Outreach Sequences + Email Finder (backend + frontend). Backend: 30/30 pytest passed (settings get/save/gap validation 400, sequence approve scheduling, run with no mailbox sends nothing, messages list filters, edit/409 after stop, LinkedIn mark-sent + 404 for email, reject, auto-stop on lead_stage=Contacted, stop sequence, cron 401/401/200 queued, sort=score ordering, RBAC 403 for caller on 12 endpoints, unauth). I used exactly 2 LLM calls: (1) Find emails on #617 TVS Motor gave 200, a second immediate call gave 409, and it finished with 4 contacts, pattern {first}.{last}@tvsmotor.com and fit 84. (2) Draft on #616 contact_index 0 returned seq 2 in 11s; all 5 docs of seq 1 were stopped with 'Replaced by new draft' and the prospect now has outreach_seq=2 pending_approval. Frontend, all working: the Outreach page (mail warning, tab counts, settings panel with the 400 toast for a bad gap and save + restore, Edit/Save, Approve sequence, bulk approve, Mark sent, Reject, channel filter, Stop sequence, 'sends <ts> UTC' and 'sends after previous step' labels), the ProspectDetail Decision makers card (fit badge, email format, 4 rows with GUESSED FROM PATTERN badges, Draft outreach buttons, Search again, Outreach link, LinkedIn icons on #617) and the Prospecting 'Best fit' sort (95, 93, 86, 84...). Nav-outreach is hidden for callers. SAFETY: all approve/stop/reject/mark-sent tests ran on TEST outreach docs I inserted directly (seq_ids 99xxxx/995001/995002, @example.com addresses), and I deleted them afterwards. I never approved a real sequence. Final state: seq 1 stopped (5), seq 2 pending_approval (5), 0 approved. No mailbox was connected. Settings were restored to enabled=true, min_score=60, daily_cap=40, drafts_per_run=10, gaps=[3,7].

minor.issue: If contact_index points to a contact with no email, the email steps are still created with to=None. Approving them later would make the send fail. Return 400 when the chosen contact has no email.

The prior sequence is stopped BEFORE the LLM call. If drafting fails (400), the old sequence stays stopped while prospect.outreach_seq still points to it. Stop the old sequence only after the new draft succeeds.
The 'to' field is not validated as an email (any string is accepted).
Returns 200 ok for a non-existent id; it should return 404.
No status check: rejected or stopped LinkedIn drafts can be marked sent.

ui_bugs.issue: A caller who opens /outreach directly gets stuck on 'Loading outreach…' with 4 'Insufficient permissions' toasts. The route Guard uses perm='leads', which callers have. Add a role guard / denied state like ProspectDetail.
No loading or disabled state during the LLM draft (11-90s). Repeated clicks create several sequences, each replacing the last.
There is no 'Rejected' tab, so rejected messages disappear from the UI entirely.
runNow has no try/catch, so a failed request gives no error toast.

action_items: Draft endpoint: validate that the chosen contact has an email, and stop the old sequence only after the new draft succeeds
Add a loading/disabled state to the Draft outreach button
Add a role guard or denied state to /outreach for callers
Optional: Rejected tab, validate the 'to' email on PATCH, 404 on reject for an unknown id, status check on mark-sent, try/catch on runNow
Security: Outreach.jsx renders the AI email body with dangerouslySetInnerHTML. The LLM output is grounded on web search, so consider sanitising it (DOMPurify)
critical_code_review_comments: fit_score gives a brand with an existing loyalty programme (e.g. Hero GoodLife) only 9 fewer points than one without, so brands that already run loyalty programmes still score 84 and get auto-drafted. Consider a bigger penalty if competitor displacement is not the goal.
run_outreach drafts up to drafts_per_run (10) LLM sequences on every manual run or cron. #617 TVS now has fit 84 + emails, so the next run will auto-draft for it (pending_approval only).
Sending is safely gated by mailer.is_connected(). Verified: with no mailbox, approved email 1 stays approved and nothing is sent.
